note: San Bernardino County regional park in the Chino Valley beside a 60-acre fishing lake; two paved loops of open, mostly unshaded sites on lawn east of the lake, with Wi-Fi. Golf, an Olympic shooting range, equestrian center, archery and disc golf around the park. --Claude
summary: County park page (fees), camping FAQ, Cedar reservation engine (headless) and imagery read. 70 bookable FHU sites (20/30/50 A, pads 46-139 ft) $45 Mon-Thu / $55 Fri-Sun, $10 reservation fee, 6 people incl. (+$5 to 8), 1 extra vehicle $10; 365-day window, 14 nights per 30 days; showers, dump; year-round. Not waterfront confirmed (nearest sites ~105 m from the lake behind road, lot and trees). Pin fine.
